name: Daan Gene Co., Ltd.
summary: Daan Gene Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of clinical diagnostic reagents and instruments. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses advanced solutions such as fluorescence quantitative PCR products, time-resolved series diagnostics, enzyme-linked immunoassay (EIA) kits, various diagnostic instruments, and specialized scientific research services. Beyond product offerings, the company extends its expertise to provide comprehensive medical examination and health management services. These encompass a wide range of offerings, from genetic susceptibility gene testing and tumor marker analysis to crucial cervical cancer screening and general routine physical examinations, alongside other personalized health support. Established in 2001, the company was originally known as Da An Gene Co., Ltd. of Sun Yat-Sen University. It is presently headquartered in Guangzhou, located in the People's Republic of China.
